Guide.title: Understand the selection process
Guide.intro: The method, limitations and evidence you can inspect in Smart LLM.
Guide.routingText: Check full input size, formatting requirements, capabilities, budget and time. Two predictors can consider two candidates before the reference model. This does not mean trying three APIs in succession.
Guide.toolsText: The calculator supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, division and parentheses. Document search reads only your selected sources. A request allows at most three generation calls and four tool executions; it cannot execute code or access arbitrary external services.
Guide.dataText: Training, calibration, threshold selection and final evaluation are split by source. Synthetic fixtures test software, not Vietnamese research quality. Predictor scores do not guarantee correct answers.
Guide.costText: Distinguish preflight estimates, provider-reported usage and USD calculated using versioned prices. Include follow-up calls and embeddings. Unknown values are not zero, and calculated cost is not a reconciled invoice.
Guide.limitsText: No qualified live result is published yet. Live models and tools require review gates. Missing artifacts or evidence fall back to an existing policy or a feasible reference. Owned history persistence is distinct from memory optimization.

errors.MODEL_ACCESS_REQUIRED: The API refused model access. Verify generation access to all three configured models in the Google project; no model substitution or automatic retry.
errors.PROVIDER_RATE_LIMITED: Gemini rate limited the request. The pilot stopped without retrying; check quota and unresolved reservations before resuming.
errors.PROVIDER_REQUEST_FAILED: The provider rejected the request. Check the HTTP status in the report and the server configuration.
errors.DISPATCH_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The previous dispatch has no completed cache. Reconciliation and manual review are required before another attempt.
errors.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: There are insufficient independent samples or label variation. Labels are never fabricated to force training.
errors.SOURCE_REVIEW_REQUIRED: The data source needs a recorded terms and training eligibility review.
errors.CODE_SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE: Docker or the pinned Python image is unavailable. Code cannot be graded yet.
errors.PILOT_FINALIZED: HOLDOUT evaluation is finalized and locked. Use the saved report.
errors.FROZEN_DEV_CHANGED: DEV was frozen before HOLDOUT; its labels and collected samples cannot change.
errors.PILOT_BUDGET_LIMIT: The total pilot cap cannot exceed USD 5, including resumed batches.
errors.PROVIDER_USAGE_EXCEEDS_RESERVATION: Provider usage exceeded its reserved limit. Cost was recorded and further dispatch stopped for review.
errors.TRAINING_BUSY: Another training job is running. Wait for it to finish and try again.
errors.TRAINING_LABELS_REQUIRED: Insufficient pass/fail labels across independent source groups. Review or expand train/calibration data.
errors.DISTILL_CACHE_MISS: Exact prompt/model/grader cache entry missing. Populate it with configured live mode.
errors.HOLDOUT_GUARDRAILS_FAILED: HOLDOUT failed. Artifact and report retained; active router preserved.
errors.SOURCE_HASH_MISMATCH: Source hash differs from the manifest. Review the input data.
errors.FOUR_INDEPENDENT_SPLITS_REQUIRED: At least four samples are required in each train, calibration, threshold and holdout split.
errors.SOURCE_SPLIT_LEAKAGE: Source groups or duplicate inputs cross splits.
errors.BUDGET_EXCEEDED: Run spending limit reached; no further API dispatch.
errors.PROCESS_INTERRUPTED: Process interrupted. Calls with uncertain costs remain reserved for reconciliation.
